symptom: drop microflow + create microflow (the route MDL-V1-REBUILD recommends) of a flow holding an activity MDL has no statement for passed check and exec and wrote the flow without it; mendixlabs/mxcli#1735 lost a Send external object, and with it every save of the external entity
cause: the reader turns such an activity into UnsupportedAction, describe prints it as a comment that parses to nothing, and the writer deliberately drops it; only the splice path (which does not rewrite it) kept it, and nothing compared a rebuilt body with the stored one
insight: Adding the missing statement (#1947) fixes one activity; the class stays open for every other UnsupportedAction, so guard the class: refuse at the pre-flight (check -p and exec run it before writing) because once a drop has run there is nothing left to keep, and refuse the rebuild path too. To exercise it end to end without a Studio Pro sample of some other unsupported type, build a variant with one reader case removed — the stored activity then reads as unsupported, which is exactly the reporter's state. Also measured on 11.12.6: Send/Delete external object in a nanoflow is CE0009, which check passed.
